title: Two-to-four hypercontractivity
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The uniform $L^4$ norm of the noise operator applied to $f$ with parameter $1/\sqrt{3}$ is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $f$:
\[\|T_{1/\sqrt{3}}f\|_4\leq \|f\|_2.\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is any real-valued function on the sign cube
the norms use the uniform measure on the sign cube
